name: First five

sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: From your comparison notes. See-through skeleton: between the ribs there is now nothing, front and back, so the background shows through, and the purple fire floats in the middle of the chest. From the front you see the spine behind it. This replaces Insurgence's solid ribs on the front with ribs drawn one by one; say if you would rather keep the solid ones there. Tail: the vertebrae are now evenly spaced and narrow steadily to the tip, in both views. Top of the back: the flat black line under the horn is gone; the horn runs straight into the skull.

note: Fifteenth look. Delta Charizard: open gaps between the bones with the fire inside, an even tail, and the line under the horn removed.
